name: Meridian Flow — SMC BOS / CHoCH breakout
rationale: Meridian Flow (WillyAlgoTrader v1.4.0) fires entries on Break of Structure (BOS = swing-level break in trend direction) and Change of Character (CHoCH = swing-level break against trend), with an optional higher-timeframe EMA bias filter and ATR-scaled SL / three-tier TP exits. Translation losses: (1) ta.pivothigh/pivotlow pivot-level detection is not in the feature registry — approximated by bb_z > breakout_z (price breaking above its recent Bollinger distribution; a structural breakout IS a high bb_z event on the relevant lookback); (2) the BOS/CHoCH trend-state machine (continuation vs reversal) collapses to a single bb_z threshold — the Finder will fit the lookback so it optimally matches the intended swing window; (3) the multi-timeframe HTF EMA filter becomes a same-timeframe MA filter via MaTrendFilter (long-only when close > MA — same directional gate, different resolution). Exit plan is faithfully ported: multi-TP partial exits at TP1 (33 % of position) and TP2 (33 %) with break-even arming after TP1, runner carries the rest to TP3. Honest prior: SMC breakout methods are popular but in automated spot backtests reduce to dressed-up momentum breakouts, which have historically been hard to fit profitably net of ~20 bps round-trip on Binance. Expected outcome: powered fail that maps the breakout parameter surface and informs whether bb_z approximation preserves any of the original swing-level edge.
catalyst: bb_z breakout above recent range (approx BOS/CHoCH swing-level break) with optional MA trend bias
